text: How was your summer vacation? How are you? I'm good. How was your summer vacation? It was great. I went to Jejudo with my family. Really? What did you do there? We looked around Jejudo. We went to many famous places. We ate mandarin oranges. We also rode horses. Did you have fun? Yes, I had a great time. How was the food? It was delicious. I want to go there, too. Let's go together next time. Sounds great! I went to the beach. I went swimming. I made a sandcastle. It was fun! I want to go there, too! Let's go together. Good idea! I went to the mountains. I went hiking. It was beautiful. I love the mountains! How was your vacation? I stayed home and read books. It was relaxing.
